## 0.5.5

- Meeting speaker separation filters correlated microphone echo and incoherent quiet noise while retaining quiet participants, absorbs small voice clusters and limits calls to eight remote speakers. Renaming to an existing name merges speakers with undo. Reruns offer a people count, keep matching names and merges, show voice-matching progress and offer to refresh an existing summary. GPU meeting transcription now keeps word timings.
- Overview statistics stay readable when the Settings window is narrow, across all themes. Long numbers shrink to fit their cards, and crowded layouts stack instead of overlapping or clipping.
- Keep chosen words and phrases capitalized with Keep capitals for under No capitals or punctuation in Writing. Add spellings such as I, Minecraft, New York or iPhone with Enter and remove them with ×; contractions and possessives keep the chosen capitals too. The list starts empty.
